items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You remember Sidney Bean? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah. He played the clarinet. He died too. He was a very good clarinet.

ctx.x: I wonder if you ever heard your father mention the name of Dark Age, George Park Hill. Oh, yes. Quite famous. Yes.
And, uh, uh, Bechet, they have a fellow named Bechet. I knew him very well, Sidney.
My daddy played with him too. He still has a brother, I think, living uptown. I was trying to find him soon. He has uptown?
